task.title: Warehouse safety and handling check (with optional work photo)
task.brief: Answer 7 short picture-style questions about real warehouse work: lifting, stacking, picking, packing and loading. Pick the safe and correct way in each. This takes about 10 minutes. Then, if you like, upload one photo of your own past work (a neat rack, a packed order, a loaded pallet) or a training certificate. Do not show any faces or customer details in the photo. The photo is optional.

rubric.label: Relevance
rubric.guide: 0 = no photo or unrelated, 3 = shows similar work, 5 = clearly shows the candidate's own work in this trade

rubric.label: Genuineness
rubric.guide: 0 = looks copied or a stock image, 3 = probably real, 5 = clearly real work or a real ITI / training certificate

rubric.label: Safety
rubric.guide: 0 = unsafe practice visible, 3 = nothing unsafe seen, 5 = good safe practice visible (PPE, neat and tidy work)

options: Sack held out in front with straight arms
